audience: Two Singapore-passport adults travelling from Singapore for a food-first Kansai holiday, April 3–9, 2027, six nights and five full sightseeing days, with SGD3,200 excluding flights; English and Simplified Chinese help the same travellers and Chinese-speaking readers without transferring Singapore-passport eligibility.

datePolicy: All listed sources retain their explicitly recorded November 6, 2026 Asia/Singapore access date (some original receipts November 5 UTC). November 6, 2026 localization is not a source refresh. Hotel price-search/stay dates, JMC final-forecast date and tariff effective dates remain separate. No external research or publication date is implied.
uncertainties: JMC retained page was the April 23, 2026 final 2026 forecast; no 2027 forecast found there. JMA April 4 normals and 2026 observed full-bloom dates are not a 2027 prediction. Ninnaji mid-April timing, 2027 seasonal admission and flower conditions remain uncertain; Kyoto congestion tool was under maintenance.

No verifiable live April hotel quotes or availability. Four indexed Expedia snapshots are unrelated historical one-night, two-adult examples. Only $ was reproduced; the earlier USD selector observation was not independently reverified, so neither confirmed USD nor SGD conversion is claimed. Final checkout/local tax, room type, cheapest-plan breakfast and cancellation remain unverified.

Nankai JPY970 each way and Namba–Morinomiya JPY240 remain provisional. April schedules/fares and future visitor bus pricing need checking; reported JPY360 proposal is not an implemented April fare. Current Railway Pass LITE expires before this trip; no successor verified. JR alternative routing is a different itinerary.

Flight times not supplied; itinerary has six nights and only five full days. All walking, transfer, crowd, meal, data, taxi and booking judgments are estimates. Unknown early flight may require a different final night/airport transfer. Substantial walking is not an accessibility assessment.

SGD1=JPY120 is a planning assumption, not a live FX quote. Room JPY180000 is unquoted cap; total JPY360000 includes JPY40200 reserve, with JPY24000 further ceiling headroom. Refundable deposits are cash tied up; top-ups not double-counted. Accommodation tax bands apply to qualifying fee, not simply half an all-in room price; invoice can be lower.

Singapore ordinary-passport short-tourism and passport-validity rules are dated observations, not other-passport eligibility or future immigration advice. Airline/transit requirements differ; VJW is free and not entry permission. No future authorization fee assumed.

Original run model unknown. Original public research did not establish every lookup in a clean isolated session; no end-to-end clean-session claim. No booking, contact, signup, payment, publication, fresh research, source edits, inventory or shared builder/checker edits for localization. Source-list/evidence links are builder provenance, not reader download promises.
editingContract: Only assigned local English/Simplified Chinese Markdown, schemaVersion 2 JSON and Kansai author-review. Preserve complete reader route/cost/entry/forecast limits and exact cross-locale literal/table-cell parity. Parent owns inventory, build and package checks; no Review, stars or website publication.
